note: Re-judged 2026-10-31 by an independent auditor who authored none of the change. RFC text (rfc7911): "In order to carry the Path Identifier in an UPDATE message, the NLRI encoding MUST be extended by prepending the Path Identifier field, which is of four octets." The only edit to test/plugin/adj-rib-in-replay-addpath-source.ci since the last judgement is f8f7628bdf, which adds a bgp-level filter { import { final accept; } export { final accept; } } with no filter refs, because RFC 8212 Section 3 now makes an EBGP direction with no explicit policy reject. No expect, reject, input or requirement-tag line changed. policy.ConcatChains keeps every peer-level ref and takes the final from the most specific configured level, so a peer-level chain still decides where one exists. An accepting final with no refs neither refuses nor rewrites a route: a withheld, stripped or discarded outcome the file asserts can still come only from the producer under test, and a delivered outcome is the eligibility the test was written under before RFC 8212; without the block the positives would fail for the wrong reason. What the unit proves is unchanged. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgements are in this file's git history.
